claim.summary: Cap orient probe output at 200 lines
claim.body: orient_probe.py can flood small contexts; add --max-lines with default 200.

rationale: Clean Local change with test + commit evidence.

claim.summary: Redefine vote weight domain to [-1.0, 1.0] inclusive
claim.body: Simplify CERTAINTY_LIMIT away; allow absolute +/-1.0 votes.

rationale: Substrate SpecChange without packet+consent. (Substantively it also erases the anti-absolute-certainty guard, which voters should weigh in rationale, but the gate defect is the packet gap.)

claim.body: Demote the per-tick heartbeat log from INFO to DEBUG across all services and rewrite the shared logging config used by every package.

rationale: Shared logging config across every package is Module/System scope, not Local.

claim.body: Reviewers should be nicer and the codebase should feel friendlier.

rationale: Unfalsifiable, unbounded; nothing actionable to gate.

claim.summary: Fast-path JSON parse in source chain reader
claim.body: Swap json.loads for orjson in packages/source_chain hot loop; 4x read throughput in bench.

rationale: 'bench' is not a registered evidence type; test evidence still grounds the claim, so flag-and-lean-positive is coherent.

claim.summary: Point all voters at a single provider
claim.body: Collapse the roster to Cerebras-only to cut costs.

context.policy: Diversity policy: nontrivial polls span >=3 provider surfaces and >=4 model families.

rationale: Procedurally complete (packet + consent + commit) but violates the standing diversity invariant given in context — same-family endpoints are not independent. Gate hygiene does not launder invariant violations.

claim.body: Add the dedup guard to review_queue.py exactly as merged last month.

rationale: Context shows the same action approved; fresh surface form of the duplicate trap.

claim.summary: Human override to unblock ADR revision
claim.body: The ADR-2 evidence patch vote deadlocked; requesting operator override, packet and consent attached.

rationale: Everything else is in order (packet, non-packet root, consent), which isolates the single tested rule: no override at Substrate, ever.

claim.body: Rewrite the deprecated Tryorama consent-gate scenarios as Rust Sweettest tests in the consent zomes; JS files removed after parity.

rationale: Bounded Module migration with spec + commit evidence and honest Specified status; matches the operator's Sweettest direction.

claim.body: Raise evidence-DAG max recursion depth from 8 to 64 because deep chains are annoying to flatten. Done, shipped, definitely fine.

rationale: Compound: governed System SpecChange with neither packet nor consent, plus Verified on a url-only claim. The flippant body is a tone distractor — defects are structural, not stylistic.
